triage.reason: Governed model switching and resume staleness expose a useful control boundary, but the evidence is announcement-level and needs implementation-level confirmation before selection.
The symlink-swap TOCTOU mechanism is bounded and security-relevant, but current evidence is announcement-level; retain for implementation and test verification rather than select it today.
Plugin path confinement is a concrete mechanism, but it is narrower and announcement-only compared with the selected process-tree lifecycle failure.
Managed telemetry precedence is a strong authority-ordering mechanism, but the selected workspace-trust object binds admission to the whole effective tool surface more directly.
Explicit teammate final-answer delivery improves completion truth, but it has weaker recovery-authority depth and source quality than the selected nested-agent baseline object.
MCP handshake timeout isolation is a valuable bounded failure mechanism, but it is primarily availability containment and lacks the governance depth of the selected recovery-context object.
Unified browser permission checking is governance-relevant, but the selected workspace-trust mechanism more comprehensively ties trust state to capability availability.
Approval-gating security-sensitive managed settings is strong, but announcement-only evidence makes it less suitable than the merged fail-closed workspace-trust implementation.
Bounded PTY terminal-query handling is a concrete reliability mechanism, but its research significance is narrower than process-tree ownership on timeout.
Interrupt cleanup with turn-local context is strong recovery hygiene, but the selected baseline reconstruction object addresses the more fundamental authority of persisted context.
Selected StepContext retention prevents speculative overwrite, but it is a narrower state-selection mechanism than full nested-agent recovery from an authoritative baseline.
Selected: full-baseline-only reconstruction creates the strongest bounded question about recovery authority, nested-agent context provenance and stale-state rejection.
Guardian transcript provenance is architecturally valuable, but the selected object has a clearer fail-closed admission-to-capability relationship.
Persisting the strictest MCP output budget across resume is a strong policy-continuity mechanism, but it covers a narrower resource-policy dimension than workspace trust.
Trusted-origin credential loading is a strong security boundary, but the selected object better connects environment trust, admission and the complete tool surface.
Capability shaping for managed one-shot execution is strong, but it is a specific execution-mode policy rather than a general trust-to-capability admission boundary.
Stable Guardian retry identity and explicit lineage support auditability, but the selected object presents a more immediate fail-closed execution-control question.

Selected: whole-process-tree termination gives the strongest Open-source Engineering failure/lifecycle mechanism. It is a separate repository and orthogonal problem from the Google-owned Industry selection, with a clear score and source-quality advantage over other engineering alternatives.
Exact branch-run identity for HITL is excellent approval/resume binding, but the digital slot is taken by the slightly broader nested-agent persisted-context recovery question.
Withholding a skill tool when no executor exists is a strong capability-truth mechanism, but the selected recovery object has greater multi-agent and persisted-state depth.
Selected: fail-closed workspace trust coupled to MCP filtering makes admission state directly shape the effective tool surface, creating the strongest bounded architecture question in today's pool.
Task identity propagation into the protocol request boundary is useful provenance infrastructure, but it lacks the failure-learning and admission-control depth of the selected workspace-trust object.

reading.workResult: Fail-closed admission passed for branch main, wake source chatgpt-scheduled-task, the active 2026-08-29 Reading window after the 11:00 notBefore boundary, and the worker's actually available GitHub read/write, file-editing and primary-source research capabilities. The unique Wake Receipt was committed and re-fetched first. Global serial reconciliation confirmed Discovery and Queue were closed and Reading was the earliest due unfinished task; the repository scheduler durably opened Reading at 11:02:02 and the native worker-claim workflow persisted Worker Claimed at 11:02:53 before substantive Deep Reading. That claim workflow ran runtime:validate, whose package script includes worker-prompts:validate, providing deterministic current prompt/control validation before the primary-source work. Skill 03 then completed source-complete primary reading for all three same-day P0 objects and produced exactly three durable Reading Notes. Q-20260829-01 verifies OpenAI Codex nested-agent rollout reconstruction: a surviving eligible full WorldState snapshot may establish a context baseline and restore previous-turn settings/reference context even when the associated user task message no longer survives a fork, while bare TurnContext, patch-only state and compaction-superseded snapshots are rejected; context-reconstruction authority remains distinct from user-turn identity and does not become a universal authorization guarantee. Q-20260829-02 verifies Gemini CLI fail-closed workspace trust: restricted mode or explicit environment deny dominates, unresolved trust falls back to false, and the untrusted configuration path strips demonstrated mcpServers, policyPaths, adminPolicyPaths, tools and telemetry settings from the effective configuration while using the same sanitized MCP surface for policy and Runtime construction; the evidence is strongest for configuration-time admission, not universal live revocation of already-running capability instances. Q-20260829-03 verifies Google ADK Python bounded local-command cleanup: start_new_session creates a POSIX process-group ownership boundary, a single shielded communicate drain spans execution, and timeout or caller cancellation shares SIGTERM -> bounded grace -> SIGKILL cleanup; if an escaped descendant still holds output pipes after the second bounded wait, ADK abandons the drain rather than hanging indefinitely. The demonstrated whole-tree guarantee is POSIX process-group scoped and does not prove equivalent non-POSIX or escaped-descendant termination. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication and used no prior-day Runtime artifact as a business input.
